evidence.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue was $479.0M, +114.7% YoY; GAAP operating margin was 25.2%.
AEC unit-shipment growth contributed over 90% of the YoY revenue increase, primarily from hyperscale customer ramps.
End-customer revenue concentration was 33%, 28%, 13% and 10% for the four disclosed large end customers.
Q1 OCF was $90.2M, capex $7.3M and SBC $88.0M; working-capital cash outflow was approximately $151.3M.
DustPhotonics purchase consideration was approximately $1.251B and recognized goodwill was approximately $895.8M.
Credo states it partnered with Oracle to develop ZeroFlap Optics to address link-flap reliability in AI data centers.
Q2 FY27 revenue guidance was $525M-$535M with GAAP gross margin 62.9%-64.9%.
At $160.31 the unchanged Base model value is $158.20/share and reverse expectations require about 18.2% annual revenue growth for years 2-10.

source_quality_notes: SEC filing and earnings exhibit are primary sources.
Reference price is secondary and not exchange-audited by the harness.
Oracle partnership wording is company disclosure; no independent contract economics were disclosed.
Valuation values are conditional estimates, not facts or target prices.
